mapper.select: SELECT FROM ad_campaign c JOIN shop s ON s.id=c.shop_id WHERE c.region=#{region} AND c.slot_type=#{slotType} AND c.audit_status=2 AND c.status=1 AND c.is_deleted=FALSE AND s.status=1 AND s.is_deleted=FALSE AND (c.daily_budget=0 OR c.spend_date IS NULL OR c.spend_date<>CURRENT_DATE OR c.spent_today<c.daily_budget) AND (c.keyword='' OR c.keyword=#{keyword}) ORDER BY c.bid_cpc DESC, c.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_campaign SET spent_today = (CASE WHEN spend_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN spent_today ELSE 0 END) + bid_cpc, total_spent = total_spent + bid_cpc, spend_date = CURRENT_DATE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND audit_status=2 AND status=1 AND is_deleted=FALSE AND (daily_budget=0 OR (CASE WHEN spend_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN spent_today ELSE 0 END) + bid_cpc <= daily_budget)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.shop_id, c.name, c.status, c.audit_status, c.total_spent, c.spent_today, COALESCE(x.click_count, 0) AS click_count, COALESCE(x.click_cost, 0) AS click_cost FROM ad_campaign c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS click_count, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS click_cost FROM ad_click_log GROUP BY campaign_id ) x ON x.campaign_id = c.id WHERE c.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND c.shop_id=#{shopId} AND c.region=#{region} AND c.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY c.id DESC
